title: Clinical Workflow Automation
short: AI agents that take repetitive admin work off the pharmacist’s desk.
problem: Insurance approvals, documentation and reminders take time away from patients.
why: Every hour returned to clinical work improves care.
solution: Narrow AI agents that draft repetitive admin work, with a pharmacist approval step before anything is sent.
limitations: Patient data must stay in secure systems

references.title: WHO — Ethics and governance of AI for health

ingredient: Small AI agents for admin tasks
directions: One agent per task. Drafts insurance requests, logs and orders — pharmacist approves before sending.
review: Nothing is sent or saved without pharmacist approval.
